events.sourceTitle: Federal Register notice 2026-20341: North American trade agreement consultation
events.summary: The Office of the United States Trade Representative announced consultation on operation of the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement before its 2027 annual joint review. Written comments and hearing requests are due January 12, 2027, at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Standard Time. The hearing date and location will be announced separately.
events.supports: Complete official document reviewed. The Federal Register header establishes publication on October 5, 2026; the October 2 filing timestamp is separate. The notice establishes a consultation and comment deadline, not a treaty amendment or new trade restriction. Canada and Mexico are relevance associations, not physical event locations. No later hearing notice was reviewed.
events.title: Consultation opens before the 2027 North American trade review
